SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

Post-Resection Colon Surveillance

Brackenfield Endoscopy Center (fictional)

Billing location: ambulatory surgical center, POS 24

Day of procedure: Oct 27, 2026

Patient identification: Ambrose Takeuchi-Varela (fictional), 67-year-old man

Colonoscopist: Evander Quarshie-Moll, MD (fictional)

Propofol given by: Saskia Lindgren-Afful, CRNA (fictional), of Brackenfield Anesthesia Associates (fictional), which
reports its own service

Prior Surgery and Cancer Care

Stage II (node-negative) adenocarcinoma of the cecum, treated by laparoscopic right hemicolectomy with a stapled
ileocolic anastomosis at Pellingham General Hospital (fictional) on Sep 30, 2025. No chemotherapy was needed. CEA
has stayed normal. This is his one-year surveillance colonoscopy. He took the split-dose preparation as instructed.

Observations by Segment

Digital rectal examination: normal.

Reach of the examination: ileocolic anastomosis, with 6 cm of neoterminal ileum viewed through it.
Cecal intubation: not applicable, because the cecum and ascending colon were removed in 2025.
Bowel preparation: good in every remaining segment.

Withdrawal time: 10 minutes.

All of the remaining colon was inspected on withdrawal.

Anastomosis: widely patent, with healthy mucosa, an intact staple line and no nodularity or recurrence.
Neoterminal ileum: normal.

Transverse colon: one 5 mm sessile polyp, resected whole by cold snare and recovered.
Descending and sigmoid colon: a few diverticula.

Rectum: normal on retroflexion.

Key Points

1. Healthy ileocolic anastomosis without recurrence.

2. Transverse colon polyp, 5 mm, removed by cold snare.
3. Left-sided diverticulosis.

Further Care

The polyp goes to Brackenfield Pathology Laboratory (fictional), which reports it separately. Next colonoscopy in
three years if the histology is benign. CT surveillance and CEA continue with his oncologist, Teodor Wambui-Faure,
MD (fictional).

Attested: Evander Quarshie-Moll, MD (fictional), Oct 27, 2026 12:31
